name: AdaniConneX Noida data centre campus
summary: AdaniConneX, the Adani group's data centre business, lists a Noida campus in the Delhi NCR region with a potential capacity of 150 MW of IT load and a first phase live from January 2025. In June 2023 the company said a USD 213 million construction loan would fund a 50 MW Noida campus then being built, alongside its Chennai site. The company says the campus can use up to 100% renewable power. The site address and tenants have not been published.

location.note: Sources name Noida only. Coordinates are the Noida city coordinates from Wikipedia (Nominatim was rate-limiting requests), not the site.

metrics.note: Listed by the company as potential capacity in IT load.

milestones.note: AdaniConneX announced a USD 213 million construction financing facility covering the Noida campus and its Chennai 1 campus.
Company lists Phase 1 as live from January 2025.

power_sources.description: Company states up to 100% renewable energy; the supply arrangement is not described.

sources.title: AdaniConneX Seals the Largest Data Center Financing Deal in India with a USD 213 Mn Construction Financing Facility

notes: The status comes from the company's undated campus page, accessed on 2026-10-09, so status_as_of is that access date. The 2023 financing was shared with the Chennai campus and is not split by site, so no investment figure is recorded here.
